metadata.title: Almost-Global Coordinates on Matrix Manifolds
metadata.abstract: We study global coordinates on smooth manifolds outside some closed subsets of measure zero. We first give an elementary proof that every compact smooth manifold admits such coordinates, allowing the Euclidean parameter domain to be disconnected. We then study parametrizations of classical matrix groups, Stiefel manifolds, Grassmannians and real flag manifolds. For these parametrizations, we describe the inverse maps and compute the codimensions of the omitted subsets. We construct these parametrizations using Cayley transforms, graphs of linear maps and block Gaussian elimination. We also give formulas for Riemannian gradients and Haar integrals in these coordinates.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 矩阵流形的几乎整体坐标
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明每个紧光滑流形在去掉一个闭零测集后可由Euclidean开域参数化，允许参数域不连通。进一步以Cayley变换、线性映射的图和分块Gauss消元，构造经典矩阵群、Stiefel流形、Grassmann流形及实旗流形的显式参数化，并给出逆映射、遗漏集的余维以及坐标中的Riemannian梯度和Haar积分公式。
techniques: 反参数化和零测遗漏集
analysis.breakthrough: 把一般的几乎整体坐标存在性变成常用矩阵流形上可计算的坐标和积分公式。
analysis.limitations: 坐标覆盖只保证去掉闭零测集后成立。遗漏集余维数值及梯度所用度量因流形而异。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第42页披露Claude用于LaTeX编辑排版、语法及交叉引用和文字一致性检查、选定计算检查与书目细节核查，记录writing、verification及literature。作者说明数学结果、证明及例子由作者完成。其他候选来自all manifolds、as tr arctan等普通文字和数学记号拼接。
